name: prompt-manager.meta-optimization-reads
purpose: Read the Guide-side meta-optimization sensors in one handle: governed share, unresolved names, discovery gaps, skill usage, and meta-optimization-manager focus next; each row unavailable on its own failure.

focus_limit.description: Rows read from focus next, 1 to 10.

assumptions: program-runtime, prompt-manager, and meta-optimization-manager are running
the skill-usage binding returns 500 on the unknown proto field `projected` as of 2026-09-02; that row reads unreliable:proto_drift_skill_usage (class binding_error) until fixed
an unavailable row is unknown, never zero
invariants: no binding with effect write or destructive is called
no row set is materialized; every reading is count, head(5), meta, or group_by
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path

signals.rows: list of {row, reading, target, in_band, unavailable, reason}: governance-share, unresolved-names, discovery-gaps, skill-usage, focus-next; target and in_band are null (pure reads); reason is scenario_unreachable or unreliable:<class>
signals.unavailable: count of rows whose binding failed

outputs.evidence: sensor command names, one per row

fixtures.note: ok is the status this board should produce; partial is accepted only for the skill-usage row (unreliable:proto_drift_skill_usage) until the binding is repaired. A refused read is recorded on its row and in errors[]; the status never becomes refused because every read is guarded per row.
